decisions.title: AGPL-3.0 for first-party NeuronAI (docs/metadata)
decisions.content:
Problem: Need open-source distribution with stronger protection against closed network/SaaS freeriding than a prior permissive license.
Decision: First-party NeuronAI is AGPL-3.0 (LICENSE, package.json metadata, docs). NOTICE removed. Brand remains under TRADEMARK.md; inbound contributions AGPL with no CLA.
Reason: AGPL remains OSI open source; network use of modified versions typically requires offering corresponding source; trademark policy stays separate from the code license.
